appearances.title: LiteParse connects MiniCPM-OCR for document parsing
appearances.summary: LlamaIndex integrated MiniCPM-OCR into LiteParse, its open-source document parser. The lightweight model runs OCR on cropped layout regions and, on ParseBench, beats Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite and PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 on content faithfulness.
